adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a legitimate architectural concern. The diff shows destinationCalendar changing from a single object to an array in CalendarEvent type (packages/types/Calendar.d.ts:171). This type is used across webhooks (webhook.e2e.ts shows destinationCalendar: [] in test expectations), emails (BrokenIntegrationEmail.tsx), and payment handlers (paypal-webhook.ts, webhook.ts). The change does expose the new array structure to public webhook payloads and couples multiple consumers to this shape. However, this is an architectural/design concern rather than a bug - the code will function correctly. The finding is grounded in specific diff changes but represents a scope/coupling concern rather than a defect.
